Class H3ClimateSystem

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.density.H3ClimateSystem
public class H3ClimateSystem extends Object
Climate system for H3 cells. Updates temperature based on: - Latitude (equator is warmer) - Season (summer/winter based on hemisphere) - Elevation (lapse rate)
